about_the_game:
🏈 Crazy Legs – an iconic figure of American football charges into the game! His ultimate ability, Touch Down, turns the battlefield into a championship finale.

Launching his signature ball, Crazy Legs delivers a powerful explosion at the aimed location. Then the ball bounces off the ground and automatically seeks out the nearest enemy, striking again. Multiple hits – multiple enemies – maximum chaos! No need for perfect aim: just land the first throw and the ball does the rest.

🎇 While flying, the ball leaves behind a trail resembling the stripes of the U.S. flag, and with every hit comes a bright flash of light, like stadium floodlights capturing a victorious moment.

💰 Crazy Legs doesn’t come empty-handed: 7,500 Yeeters Bucks — upgrade your armor and weapons with in-game currency!
